title: Capstone: Production RAG Platform
description: Ship a production-style RAG platform: ingestion → retrieval → evaluation → API → monitoring → deployment. Multiple document formats, hybrid retrieval with evaluation-gated reranking, regression-tested quality, traced serving with rollout controls, and an operations runbook.
learningObjectives: Integrate ingestion, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and generation into one deployable system
Gate retrieval-quality regressions with regression tests in CI
Serve with tracing, metrics, and staged rollout
Operate: runbook covering refresh, rollback, and drift detection

milestones.title: Ingestion + hybrid retrieval
milestones.objective: Ingest ≥3 formats; implement hybrid retrieval (sparse + dense) with config-controlled fusion.
milestones.expectedOutput: Deterministic index; config switches blend strategy.

milestones.title: Evaluation-gated reranking
milestones.objective: Add a reranker behind a config flag; enable only if it improves the fixed-set metrics.
milestones.expectedOutput: Before/after metric table proving the rerank decision.

milestones.title: Quality regression suite
milestones.objective: Turn the evaluation set into CI regression tests with thresholds; a failing run blocks merge.
milestones.expectedOutput: CI workflow failing on quality regression.

milestones.title: Serving + rollout + ops
milestones.objective: Serve with traces/metrics, staged rollout flag, and runbook (index refresh, rollback).

categories.minimumExpectation: Hybrid beats single-method on the fixed set
categories.excellentExpectation: Reranker enabled/disabled decision backed by ablations

architecture: ingest → index (sparse+dense) → retrieve → rerank (flagged) → generate → serve
constraints: Capstone must deploy or run fully via Docker
hints: Scope control matters: the fixed evaluation set from Phase 11 is your foundation — extend it, don't restart
